Star Voyage Signalman (Korean: 별여행 기차 신호수, byolryohaeng gicha sinhosu) is Crackle Corn's second Costume, released in the first half of the Voyage to the World of Dreams update. It is an Epic Costume that can be obtained by drawing it from the Vintage Costume Jar in the Gem Exchange Center.

Story

As the very last passenger steps onto the Star Voyage Express, it's time for Crackle Corn to get to work! With a brilliant pop-pop, it alerts everyone to the train's departure. Whenever the tracks seem to twist and warp or the starfog grows too thick, another pop-pop! sets the train right back on the correct path to ensure a safe voyage. It's almost like it was made for this job!

Trivia

  • Star Voyage Signalman was released alongside,  Guide to Sweet Dreams,  Naptime Buddy,  Moonlight Express Engineer,  Moonlight Conductor,  Dreamy Cradle Crafter,  Dreamy Party Planner,  Buzzy Dreaming,  Dreamy Pie Pâtissière,  Dreamy Pie Bakery,  Star Voyage Guide, and  Dreamy Party Guest.
  • Originally, Star Voyage Signalman was obtainable by purchasing it with Gold Gems in the Gem Exchange Center during the Voyage to the World of Dreams season.

Happy Town Pie Crier (Korean: 신나는 파이 알리미, sinnaneun pai allimi, "Exciting Pie Informant") is Crackle Corn's first Costume, released in the first half of the Our Special Pie Party! update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Hear ye, hear ye! Candy Corn Cookie has arrived! Cackle Corn announces her arrival with a distinct POP! before even the scent of the delicious pies can waft through the town. Seems like hungry Cookies should keep an ear open for Cackle Corn's cries!

Trivia

  • Happy Town Pie Crier was released alongside  Pie Delivery Scout,  Crow Wizard,  March to Dreamland,  Devilish Than a Devil,  Angelic Than an Angel,  Swashbuckling Pirate,  Wizard's Apprentice,  Dreamland Lullaby,  Infernal Demon,  Flaming Angel, and  One-Eyed Pirate.
